messages:
Elaine: idea: run a hands-on webinar \/ 'prompt clinic' format. short framing + breakout sandboxes + capstone demos. aim = concrete takeaways on latency vs cost vs quality. thoughts?

Matt: yes. keep it ~75min, say 15m framing, 40m labs, 15m demos, 5m wrap. need clear attendee setup instructions.

Sanju: infra note: ephemeral sandboxes required with token caps. can provision on staging Dedicated. will script it.

Sanju: example CLI:
```bash
redwoodctl sandbox create --model redwood-vicuna-13b-q4 --ttl 70m --token-quota 3500 --label webinar-2026
```

Leah: capture which lane attendee picks (latency|cost|quality) + infra interest (hosted|dedicated|private) and route in HubSpot. also add trial opt-in.

Jess: speakers: Elaine intro, Sanju infra clinic, 1 customer case, Matt moderates capstone. i'll ping customers and collect 2-paragraph abstracts.

Oliver: i'll pre-record a 3min failover clip (switch to hosted small model) in case sandboxes hit limits. drop into ops playbook.

Matt: rehearsals: 30m run-through for onboarding flow, 15m tech check day before. avoid long dress rehearsals.

deploy-bot: Notice: maintenance on inference-dedicated-pool 2026-05-02 02:00-02:30 UTC. avoid scheduling conflicts.

Elaine: all owners please confirm one-line: I'll compile ops checklist + attendee blurb.

Matt: i'll own the run-throughs and moderate.

Sanju: i'll own sandbox provisioning and quotas.

Leah: i'll own lead form & routing.

Jess: i'll own speaker outreach and abstracts.

Oliver: i'll own failover recording.

Elaine: thanks team ":rocket:""
